effect_description_eng:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Until your opponent's turn ends, give 1 of their Digimon or Tamers "[End of Your Turn] Delete 1 of your Digimon."
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your opponent's Digimon are played or deleted, by trashing any 2 of this Digimon's digivolution cards, you may play 1 level 4 or lower purple Digimon card from your trash without paying the cost.
